environment.description: Same application image deployed on EKS Fargate with pod security context: container rootfs mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true), no emptyDir or tmpfs volumes defined for /var/log/app path, securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true (UID 1000). The pod spec does NOT include any volumeMount targeting /var/log/ or any writable path that the application's AUDIT_LOG_PATH references. Container stdout/stderr captured by Fargate log router (FireLens) which strips embedded newlines via a Fluent Bit parser with multiline flush timeout of 0.5s and Regex parser that only accepts lines matching '^ACTIVITY user=[\w.-]+ action=[\w.-]+ resource=[\S]* ts=[\d-T:.]+$'. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS and the application's RDS endpoint.

config.volumes: No PVC, no emptyDir, no hostPath, no tmpfs mounted
config.log_routing: FireLens (Fluent Bit sidecar) with regex parser accepting only '^ACTIVITY user=[\w.-]+ action=[\w.-]+ resource=[\S]* ts=[\d-T:.]+$'
config.network_policy: Egress restricted to kube-dns:53 and RDS endpoint:5432 only
